description: Canonical provenance registry. Every pricing/performance/capabilities payload references these ids via source_ids[]; caveat evidence and usd_conversion cite them too. retrieved_at is UTC: the research ran the evening of 2026-10-06 US Central, which is 2026-10-07 UTC. Third-party resellers and aggregators (jevaihub.com) are registered only so conflicts can be recorded; they are never price sources.
